layers.note: farthest; almost still when the camera pans
next biome island; moves a little when the camera pans
atmospheric veil; sits over the far island, under the playfield

parallax_note: Each layer is drawn at its anchor, then shifted by (camera_pan_x * parallax, camera_pan_y * parallax). Smaller parallax = farther. The playfield itself is parallax 1.0 and is not part of this plate. anchor="fill" layers are sized to the viewport; others are placed at anchor [x,y] top-left.
